jobs.title: Staff IT Engineer
jobs.description_text:
About Abridge
Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.
Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.
We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.
The Role
As a Staff IT Engineer, you will be a technical leader responsible for driving efficiency and scale across the entire corporate IT infrastructure and enterprise ecosystem. You will design, build, and maintain mission-critical automation solutions that eliminate manual processes, enhance security posture, and improve the employee experience globally. This role requires deep engineering expertise, an IT product mindset for automation, and the ability to mentor junior team members while tackling the organization's most complex integration and scaling challenges. You will work directly with IT leadership, Security leadership, and department heads across the company.
Operating at the intersection of healthcare AI and enterprise IT, you will be expected to architect and enforce automation standards that meet the rigorous demands of a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2-audited environment.

What You'll Do

- Workflow Automation: Develop scalable, resilient workflow automation solutions to streamline critical business processes, including onboarding/offboarding, access requests, compliance enforcement, and self-service IT support.

- API and Integration Development: Serve as the subject matter expert for integrating disparate systems by building robust, fault-tolerant connections using APIs and event-driven architectures.

- Identity and Access Management (IAM): Drive automation within the IAM infrastructure, focusing on automated role assignment, least-privilege policy enforcement, and audit-friendly logging of authentication and authorization events.

- Enterprise Data Engineering: Architect and engineer robust data platforms for IT, ensuring efficient collection, normalization, and secure storage of high-volume enterprise data for reporting, audit, and advanced analytics.

- Technical Leadership: Act as a force multiplier for the team — establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, documenting architectures, and mentoring engineers in automation principles.

- Business Systems & Custom Application Deployment: Own the end-to-end deployment and lifecycle management of business-critical systems and custom-built applications, from architecture and vendor evaluation through implementation, integration, and ongoing support — ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise IT standards.

What You'll Need

- Experience: 10+ years in IT Engineering, IT Apps Development, or DevOps, with at least 5 years dedicated to large-scale enterprise automation.

- Cloud & Platform Expertise: Deep hands-on experience automating complex operations and governance across GCP, AWS, and/or Azure. You will bring an ability to build and modularize infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (i.e. Terraform).

- Programming Proficiency: Highly proficient in at least one modern programming language; strong preference for Python.

- Systems Integration: Proven experience with REST/GraphQL APIs and querying and managing relational databases (SQL strongly preferred).

- Automation Platforms: Extensive experience designing and managing centralized automation platforms (e.g., n8n, SOAR, Ansible, Workato, or custom frameworks).

- Compliance Context: Experience operating in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, or similar) with exposure to SOC 2, HIPAA, or equivalent compliance frameworks.

- Communication: Able to communicate effectively across a wide range of audiences — from engineers to GTM stakeholders, from individual contributors to executives.

Bonus Points

- Experience with agentic AI or ML models applied to IT automation (proactive issue detection, intelligent routing, NLP).

Why Work at Abridge?
At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.
Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.
Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.
We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.
If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

- Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

- Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

- Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

- Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

- Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

- 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

- Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

- Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

- Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

- Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

- Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

- Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

- ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer
Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud
We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

jobs.title: EHS Specialist
jobs.description_text:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:
The Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist is a critical member of Skydio's expanding EHS organization. You will support Headquarters, R&D, Field Operations, and deployment activities while helping build the EHS programs, systems, and operating structure these functions need as they scale. Unlike traditional site-based safety roles, this position operates across office and laboratory spaces, engineering and R&D areas, field deployment locations, customer sites, public-safety facilities, rooftops, and other non-traditional work environments. You'll work closely with EHS Leadership, Field Operations, Deployment Engineering, R&D, Facilities, Training, and business leaders to identify hazards, implement controls, support regulatory compliance, investigate incidents, deliver training, and establish scalable EHS processes. A major part of this role is building EHS infrastructure for business areas that have not historically had dedicated EHS support.

Location:
This is an office based position at our HQ in San Mateo, CA. Travel is required based on operational need and may include customer deployment locations, public-safety facilities, rooftop installations, remote field locations, other Skydio sites, and incident-investigation, training, and audit locations.

How you'll make an impact:
• Support development and implementation of EHS programs across Headquarters, R&D, Field Operations, and deployment activities.
• Partner with EHS Leadership to build new divisional safety programs, procedures, training, inspection systems, risk assessments, and operational controls.
• Conduct field and site safety assessments for deployments, installations, customer locations, and remote operations.
• Perform Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), pre-task risk assessments, and site-specific risk assessments, and recommend engineering, administrative, PPE, and procedural controls.
• Support safe work practices for rooftop work, work at height, ladder use, electrical activities, batteries, environmental exposure, and public/customer-site operations, including roof access, roof hatches, skylights, roof edges, load limitations, exclusion zones, and competency requirements for elevated work.
• Establish weather-related work restrictions for wind, rain, lightning, ice, extreme heat, and other field conditions.
• Investigate injuries, incidents, near misses, property damage, and significant hazards; identify root causes, establish corrective actions, assign owners, and track actions through closure.
• Develop and deliver EHS training to employees, managers, field teams, engineers, and other affected personnel.
• Support contractor and vendor safety programs, including pre-task risk assessment and contractor qualification.
• Maintain EHS documentation, training records, inspection records, incident records, and corrective-action tracking, and support emergency preparedness and response planning.
• Support EHS audits, inspections, regulatory readiness, PPE management, and continuous-improvement initiatives; collect and analyze EHS performance data to support dashboards, trends, and reporting.
• Maintain a visible, collaborative EHS presence across supported business groups and sites, partnering with leaders and employees to identify unsafe conditions and improve safety culture.
• Participate in new process, equipment, facility, deployment, and change-management reviews, and support EHS Leadership in establishing scalable systems that apply consistently across domestic and, as applicable, international operations.

What makes you a good fit:
• 3+ years of progressive EHS specialist-level experience.
• Degree in Environmental Health & Safety, Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.
• Working knowledge of OSHA general-industry requirements, and familiarity with fall protection, ladder safety, PPE, Hazard Communication, electrical safety, LOTO, emergency preparedness, ergonomics, and incident investigation.
• Experience conducting JHAs, risk assessments, inspections, and incident investigations.
• Experience supporting field operations, construction, installations, engineering, R&D, manufacturing, or facilities environments.
• Ability to interpret regulations and translate requirements into practical operational controls.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining close partnership with operational teams.
• Comfortable operating in fast-changing environments where programs and processes are still being developed.
• Comfortable working in both traditional office environments and active field environments that may involve weather exposure, ladders, rooftops, powered equipment, batteries, electrical systems, construction-type activities, and interaction with customers or contractors.
• Ability to travel as business needs require, climb ladders and stairs, access rooftops, walk field sites, and respond to EHS incidents and urgent operational needs.

Preferred Qualifications:
• OSHA 30-Hour General Industry or Construction, First Aid/CPR/AED certification or Trainer credentials, and Fall Protection Competent Person training
• Board certification (ASP, CSP, CHST, OHST, or similar)
• Experience with ISO 45001/14001 or other management-system frameworks, VelocityEHS or another EHS management system, and developing safety programs from the ground up
• Experience supporting public-safety, drone/UAS, aviation, construction, deployment, telecommunications, or rooftop work

Compensation:
At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $90,000 - $110,000. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company's group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company's policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position's location.

#LI-JF1

At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.
For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit https://www.e-verify.gov/

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role
Join Replit's key teams across the company, such as AI Research, Strategic Finance, or the Office of the CEO, for a unique paid internship built for sharp quantitative and creative minds. You will work alongside our top executives, in addition to world-class engineers, designers, and finance team on some of the hardest problems in AI-native software creation and accelerating key areas of our business.

We are creating a dedicated track for students with strong mathematical backgrounds because the problems we are solving sit at the intersection of deep math and applied AI, including agent reasoning, systems optimization, and improving how our models learn and perform at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of users build software.

You Will:

- Contribute to real engineering problems that push the boundaries of AI-powered software creation

- Prototype novel approaches to problems in AI, systems, or tooling where mathematical rigor is the differentiator

- Ship work that impacts millions of developers globally, in an environment where your ideas are heard and often implemented

Required Skills and Experience:

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field

- At least one semester of schooling remaining after the internship

jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.description_text:
About Concourse
Concourse builds AI agents for corporate finance teams.

We connect core enterprise data sources and deploy AI agents that can analyze the data through natural language, deliver insights in seconds, and enable our customers to make better decisions. Since launching less than a year ago, Concourse has grown extremely rapidly. Our AI agents are deployed across hundreds of high-growth companies, unicorn startups like Persona, Front, Lightmatter, and large public companies - including multiple Fortune 500 customers.

Concourse is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, CRV, YC, Standard Capital, and 50+ angel investors from companies like OpenAI, Cursor, Vercel, Brex, Carta, Rippling, 1Password, Deel, Jeeves, and DoorDash.

About the Role
We're hiring an AI Deployment Strategist to build and deploy AI agents for our customers, working alongside our CTO and forward deployed engineering team.

Your mission is to scale the impact of our AI agents across every finance team we serve. You’ll work directly with customers to understand their workflows, design product experiences that increase adoption, and build systems that ensure Concourse becomes core to their financial operations.
You'll work closely with our founders and engineers to work directly on deployments and learn how these systems work from the inside. You'll think strategically about what unlocks customer value, prioritize use cases, and build out agent workflows. Your work will directly shape how we grow to thousands of customers and define how finance teams interact with AI & agents.

This is a high-impact role for someone who has a strong understanding of finance, problem solving, and thrives at the intersection of product, data, and customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

- Build agents for customers: Design, configure, and tune AI agent workflows against each customer's data, systems, and reporting conventions, and iterate these outputs with finance teams.

- Optimize AI & Prompt Performance: Maintain prompt libraries, tune model configurations, and ensure high-quality outputs for finance use cases.

- Identify and prioritize use cases: Sit with finance teams to map their recurring workflows, then judge which are highest-value, most repeatable, and best suited to an agent.

- Run deployments with the forward deployed engineering team: Scope, build, and launch deployments, aligning on business goals and ensuring quick time-to-value.

- Build Analytics & Insights: Create dashboards and analytics that reveal customer behavior, product usage patterns, and revenue expansion opportunities.

- Inform GTM Strategy: Identify patterns across customers to refine positioning, messaging, onboarding playbooks, and expansion strategies.

- Design High-Impact Customer Journeys: Optimize onboarding, training, and lifecycle experiences that help finance teams reach first value faster and become long-term power users

- Build Customer Health Frameworks: Develop systems for segmentation, health scoring, expansion signals, and proactive account insights.

- Architect Finance System Integrations: Work across ERPs, banks, CRMs, HRIS tools, and custom databases to design scalable agent capabilities and prompts

About You

- 1-3 years in finance, investment banking, consulting, FP&A, finance operations, or data and systems roles supporting finance teams

- Deep understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, and how finance teams operate, and the workflows they perform

- Experience vibe-coding, passionate about AI and finding opportunities to automate systems

- Proficient in SQL, comfortable writing queries for analysis, building and testing eval sets, debugging issues, and working with customer data

- Familiarity with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, PowerBI) and data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, etc.)

- Experience with finance systems (QBO, Ramp, NetSuite, Intacct, Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, etc.) and relevant finance tasks that pull from these systems (preferred but not required)

- Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and is able to self-direct, move quickly, and operate with high ownership in a startup setting

- Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or tuning AI outputs for analytical or operational workflows (preferred but not required)

Why You Should Join Us

Joining Concourse is an incredible opportunity to get in at the ground level of a high-growth, category-defining AI company. Every person we hire meaningfully shapes the product, culture, and trajectory of the business, and we compensate accordingly with top-of-market salary and equity.

You’ll have a high degree of ownership from day one. We move fast, build aggressively, and operate with very little bureaucracy. You’ll work directly with the founders and founding team, ship impactful work weekly, and play a core role in scaling the company.

We’re in person 5 days a week in our new NYC HQ in Flatiron, where we collaborate tightly, iterate quickly, and build an environment that’s both high-energy and deeply focused. We believe the best work, and the fastest learnings, happen together.

We care about your growth. You’ll get direct mentorship, opportunities to stretch into new skills across engineering, AI, and GTM, and the support of a team that wants you to succeed. This is a place to accelerate your career, build your brand, and make an outsized impact.
